prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single tight dialogue portrait for a gritty medieval pixel-art RPG, intended to resolve at 74 by 100 pixels.
Primary request: substantively REDRAW the person from identity reference image 1 as a large-face portrait; do not merely crop the old full body. Images 2–5 are style references Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore ONLY: use their coarse connected pixel clusters, sculptural angular face planes, tiny dark eyes and compact framing; do not copy their identities.
Composition: 74:100 portrait aspect ratio, transparent RGBA canvas. Head and face occupy almost all the image; full crown, hair/kerchief outer silhouette and visible ear must be intact with real clear transparent margin equivalent to 3 pixels at 74x100 on top and both sides. Short neck only, narrow collar at bottom, no chest or wide shoulders. Slight three-quarter view looking toward image left like identity reference. Simple hard stair-step silhouette and crisp large color regions. If tool outputs a large raster, make it visibly constructed from a coarse 74x100 pixel grid rather than detailed painting.
Pixel language: sturdy nose bridge and large nose/cheekbone planes, strong jaw, muted earth tones, very restrained highlights. Small deep-set dark eyes with no bright white sclera bars, no eye shine. Age through a few broad planes, not many hatch lines. Hair in 4–6 broad joined masses, no parallel etched strands or scattered single-pixel sparkle. No gradients, soft airbrush, blur, dithering, photographic skin, thin embroidery, glamour, generic worried eyebrows, chibi proportions, anime eyes, text, border, objects, hands or scenery. Aim at at most 32 opaque working colors and strictly binary transparent/opaque alpha. This is a new portrait, not a full-body sprite.

Subject: LUOFU / 洛芙 / FOR-NPC-LUOFU, a sturdy adult WOMAN in her THIRTIES, a working drainage-channel and household-water maintainer. Preserve the exact broad square lower jaw, wide flat nose, deep-set small dark eyes, thick straight eyebrows and broad grounded face of identity image 1. Dark brown plain hair is tucked tightly under a securely tied aged CREAM headscarf, with the compact tied knot and tails behind the ear all completely inside the canvas. Do not replace the square face with a sweet narrow face. Preserve tan skin and practical unsentimental brisk alertness, composed firm mouth and level no-nonsense brow; not an angry caricature or sad heroine. Keep the olive-green worn work smock, tiny cream neckline and faint ochre apron-strap edge from the original as only a narrow collar at bottom. No big shoulders or low neckline, no curls or loose flyaway strands. She is confidently checking what is actually in front of her; no drinking, sample bottles, water certification, slogans or tools in the portrait.
